error_body: That page does not exist in this language, or does not exist at all.
home_intro: Jekyll builds this site once per language. Not one sentence lives inside a template: every visible string is looked up in a JSON dictionary that the Multilocale CLI writes into _data/.
home_missing_body: Polyglot merges the default-language dictionary underneath the active one, so a key nobody has translated yet renders in the default language instead of vanishing. A half-finished translation never ships a blank page.
home_missing_title: What a missing translation looks like
home_step_1_body: A layout asks for site.data.strings.home_headline. Jekyll resolves that key against the dictionary of the language it is currently building, so one file renders in every language.
home_step_2_body: Translators work in the web app or in the terminal. Fixing a typo in Italian never means editing a template or waiting for a pull request.
home_step_3_body: multilocale download rewrites every _data/{lang}/strings.json file. Commit the result and the site keeps building offline and in CI, account or no account.
site_tagline: A multi-language website built with Jekyll and Multilocale
translation_missing_notice: This page has not been translated into this language yet. You are reading the default-language version.
